sources: refs/glute_ham_raise/ref.md, Motion: about 90° of knee at the top to 0-10° at the bottom; the hip doesn't flex

lines.says: the knees go from bent about 90°, thighs upright, to nearly straight, the body level
the hips stay straight: the thigh and the trunk make one line through the rep
the hip angle holds: the hamstrings work, not a hinge at the hips
the feet stay planted on the plate
the hips travel forward and down about the knees as the body lowers
the arms hang and take no load
the knees rest on the pads at the top, the thighs along them at the bottom
the ankles sit between the rollers and the soles are flat on the plate
the body lowers as one straight line, the head in line with the spine
